companies.title: Companies to check
companies.description: One line per company: a domain (stripe.com), a careers URL (https://jobs.lever.co/leverdemo) or any ATS board slug. Every company is resolved on its own and reported back, so a company with no open roles is visible in the run report instead of vanishing.

keywords.title: Filter by job title
keywords.description: Only jobs whose title contains any of these words, comma separated - e.g. engineer, sales, python. Empty = every open job. You are not charged for jobs the filter drops.

location.title: Filter by location
location.description: Case-insensitive substring of the job location, e.g. London, Berlin, US. Empty = all locations.

onlyRemote.title: Only remote jobs
onlyRemote.description: true = keep only jobs the company itself marks as remote.

includeDescription.title: Include full job descriptions
includeDescription.description: true = add the complete job description as plain text to every row. Rows become much larger; the price per job does not change.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Safety stop per company. 0 = every matching job on the board.

maxCompanies.title: Max companies per run
maxCompanies.description: Safety stop: the run never touches more than this many companies.

includeEmptyCompanies.title: Add a row for companies with no jobs
includeEmptyCompanies.description: false = companies we could not resolve are listed in the run report (storage key COMPANY_REPORT) only. true = each one also becomes a dataset row with status NO_JOBS and the reason, so nothing is missed downstream.

cacheMinutes.title: Reuse a recent result for this many minutes
cacheMinutes.description: Checking the same company again inside this window is served from this account's own cache instead of hitting the board once more: faster runs, and the source sees no duplicate traffic. 0 = always fetch live. A company we could not resolve is cached for half the window only, so a board that was briefly down recovers quickly.
